items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in the first half of 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage - described by the company as off the charts - is driving the gap.

items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: The appointment brings a senior mining executive with experience across major commodity markets into Albemarle at a consequential point for the global lithium industry.

items.headline: Why Is Albemarle (ALB) Up 5.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.snippet: Albemarle posted second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.75 per share, up from 11 cents a year ago, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.35 by 11.9%, supported by stronger lithium pricing.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range, down from a prior mid-$20 view, and expects Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $668 million, down from $858 million in Q2.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166, citing lithium prices coming off somewhat in Q2 but a market that remains tight.
